name: GORR THE GOD BUTCHER
description: Wielding All-Black the Necrosword, Gorr is the nightmare of all gods. The divine flesh he rends is reshaped into an endless tide of black berserkers, forever marching in his wake. When the God Butcher's unholy legion descends, beings both mortal and divine become sacrifices beneath his feet!
lore: Most mortals fear the wrath of the gods, but the gods fear the wrath of Gorr! With All-Black the Necrosword in hand, Gorr has spent centuries carving his way through divine pantheons, truly earning the title of God Butcher! Once a devout believer, Gorr's prayers were never answered. After his family perished, Gorr discovered a gateway that led beyond time and space. Arriving at the God Quarry, he learned a cruel truth: the gods had heard his prayers, but never cared enough to answer. That day, his unholy crusade began!

abilities.name: All-Black
abilities.description: Unleash up to a 4-strike rapid combo with All-Black the Necrosword

stats.Damage: 40 for the 1st/3rd hits, 60 for the 2nd/4th hits
stats.Attack Interval: 0.4s for the 1st/3rd hits, 0.6s for the 2nd/4th hits

abilities.name: Necro-Power
abilities.description: Charge and launch a symbiote mass forward. Hitting an enemy Slows and teleports nearby Black Berserkers to them, or spawns a new one. Arriving Berserkers unleash a two-strike melee attack to Launch Up nearby enemies before reverting to ranged mode

abilities.name: Shadow Harvest
abilities.description: Warp to a selected Black Berserker, sacrificing it for Bonus Health equal to half its Health and triggering a symbiote explosion. Briefly unlocks Shadow Scythe: fire a piercing shockwave forward. All-Black then becomes a scythe for a set duration or 4 slashes

stats.Bonus Health: 50% of the Black Berserker's remaining Health, up to 50; shares the Bonus Health cap with Berserker Swarm

abilities.name: Black Berserker
abilities.description: Lob a symbiote mass that spawns a Black Berserker on landing to immediately shoot the nearest enemy. If summoned beside an enemy via Necro-Power, it unleashes a two-strike melee attack instead

abilities.name: Living Abyss
abilities.description: Surge forward as an Invincible symbiote mass, leaving a Black Berserker behind and driving all active Berserkers into a Frenzied State. Upon landing, manifest a Necroverse that continuously damages trapped enemies, converting them into Bonus Health

abilities.name: Berserker Swarm
abilities.description: Black Berserker damage grants Gorr Bonus Health. Defeating an enemy instantly spawns a Black Berserker at their location

stats.Summon Damage/Health Conversion: 100%, up to 50; shares the Bonus Health cap with Shadow Harvest

abilities.name: Twilight of the Gods
abilities.description: Unseal All-Black's true power, transforming it into the Annihilablade. Upon activation, an expanding Necroverse is formed, instantly spawning a Black Berserker next to all enemies caught inside. While active, every slash of the Annihilablade deals devastating damage. The Necroverse moves with Gorr; Berserkers within the field will not expire and remain locked in a perpetual Frenzied State

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 8m, decreasing to 80% at 10m

base.description: Gain a new ability to morph the All-Black into a scythe and execute a sweeping strike, damaging and briefly Grounding nearby enemies. The weapon stays in scythe form for a short duration.

enhanced.description: When teaming up with Hela, the scythe's attack range is expanded. Each hit scatters symbiote fragments, granting Bonus Health to Gorr and nearby allies

base.description: Gain a new ability to fire a Symbiote Claw forward, dealing piercing damage to enemies in its path. Upon reaching max distance, it retracts, Launching caught enemies toward Gorr.

enhanced.description: When teaming up with Venom, Black Berserkers receive a slight Damage Boost and apply a Slow effect to enemies they strike
